body.description: Use `query` for the (valid) ES|QL query, `size` to bound the number of sampled values, and `include_sample_values` to opt into the data-node value/range sampling. `cursor` is a nested, tagged object naming the caret's offset unit and value; it must contain exactly one of `utf8` (byte offset into the query's UTF-8 encoding), `utf16` (code-unit offset, i.e. a plain JavaScript/Java string index), or `codepoint` (Unicode code-point offset, i.e. a plain Python string index), e.g. `{"utf16": 12}`.
